_: Town building knobs (towns.gd reads them). castle: where a great house's castle may stand when the first, old search (eight headings on the square's ring, all dry) finds no plot: headings around, rings out from the square (0 is the old ring; -1 hugs the square), sizes tried in order, and the share of the plot's edge that may stand over water if the keep's middle is dry.
_sets: castles: pack (the realistic kit's castle and longhall) or kit (castle_builder.gd raises each great house's castle, and house_builder.gd its hall, from the Quaternius kit, sized to the seat's rank: data/assets.json castle.kit); --castles=kit for one run. houses: pack or kit (house_builder.gd's townhouses, cottages and inn in place of the downloaded houses); --houses=kit. Kit roofs and banners take the holder's colour with team colour on (look.json team).
_density: density: how many houses a town raises (towns.gd _real_lots): base + per_size x its size, held between min and max, seat more at a great house's seat; crown: the crown's seat only (art target 01-town, plots shoulder to shoulder behind the square): extra houses, ring_pack (houses' spacing on the rings past the square as a share of their width; 0.95 elsewhere), ring_jitter (the extra gap's most, in units; 0.3 elsewhere), street_gaps (the share of street plots left as a yard or alley; 0.14 elsewhere).
